question: By what means does the speaker come to know the determination of Kaula?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas.
The speaker has come to know something.
That knowing occurs by the grace of the addressed lord.
The object known is the determination of Kaula.
inference: By the lord's grace, the speaker knows the determination of Kaula.
uncertainties: Prior state of ignorance not detailed.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of Kaula.
